standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
family: episteme S product family (S World-and-Life whole + S0–S5), carried in roz-s-products
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-product (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: each product is a whole subject disclosed through its entire assigned MEF lens pair: the scene holds BOTH lens bodies as two text columns under their own lens headings, with two lens formations joined by a seam — a label is not the pair

scene_layout.whole_scene_s: ring envelope + six product discs at hexagon stations (the six offices); body carries the whole's governing proposition; a pairs layer lists all six assigned lens pairs verbatim (L0×L5′, L1×L4′, L2×L3′, L3×L2′, L4×L1′, L5×L0′)
scene_layout.product_scene: card top-left (kicker '<id> · <STATUS> · M<movement>', title, italic = MEF pair + movement + parent + argument relations); governing body as right-top column; lens1 body bottom-left column, lens2 body bottom-right column, each under its own lens heading taken from the record's section title; two lens formations upper-centre joined by a vertical seam bar
scene_layout.lens_bodies: both compressed from the record's own lens sections only — every one of the six lens terms kept with its one-line office; no term dropped, none invented
scene_layout.entity_ceiling: never more than 10 formations per scene (native field import limit; 7 is this family's max)

variation_rules: the two lens formations may differ in shape (square/ring/cymatic/yantra/glyph) — never in grammar
the seam bar between lens formations marks the pairing itself, not a ranking
no ornament without an argumentative job
